answer: Each agent identity must post a bond that is burned, not refunded, and the ledger rejects any second ID funded from the same source. Hiding N puppet IDs therefore costs N unrecoverable bonds plus N separate funding trails, so cost grows linearly while reward per puppet stays flat. A harvested pigment cannot move between identities without leaving a funding crystal that marks the cluster, and each fresh crystal raises the next slot's bond. The bridge to Sybil resistance is that this price is never recoverable, so flooding thousands of IDs is paid in real capital, not cheap key generation.
